content: मशकः [मश्-वुन्] .²1 A mosquito, gnat; सर्वं खलस्य चरितं मशकः करोति <ls>H. 1. 78</ls>; <ls>Ms. 1. 45</ls>. .²2 A particular disease of the skin. .²3 A leather water-bag. .²4 <ab>N.</ab> of a district in Śākadvīpa inhabited by Kṣatriyas. .²5 Gadfly, any fly that stings (दंशमशक); <ls>Mb. 3. 141. 27</ls>. .{@-की@} A female mosquito; मद्गेहे मशकीव मूषकवधूः … … <ls>Sūkti. 5. 19</ls>.
